title: Focus HUD
idea: Focus HUD: Objective and essential resources frame a readable playfield
audience: People who need to play within a game surface.
worksWellWhen: Players need minimal actionable world context
avoidWhen: UI would obscure the main play area
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its play priority and explicit commitment contract: Never show victory before authoritative game state
navigation: Focus HUD keeps the current play context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Objective and essential resources frame a readable playfield
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to play; players need minimal actionable world context
composition.priority: Never show victory before authoritative game state

imagery.role: Support the actual play context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Place essentials within configurable safe zones
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the focus hud structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no play content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Never show victory before authoritative game state
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized play content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Never show victory before authoritative game state
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active play context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
